description: Agent Coordination: submit how a group of agents handles a disagreement or a stall, as its escalation path, its past escalations, or both: where the path is written (a runbook, the work plan, configuration, only inside an agent prompt, or nowhere), who receives an escalation by name and whether that is the principal, a lead, an operator or other, whether it covers disagreements, stalls or both, what starts it (a time limit, a number of attempts, a threshold, an agent’s judgment or nothing) with its value, and whether escalations are recorded; and each past escalation with its reason, who raised it and when, who it went to, when it was resolved, how it ended (decided, withdrawn, timed out or unresolved) and the decision recorded. The signed report gives the path, every escalation and the outcomes counted, and names an escalation that is missing: a path written nowhere, a path that exists only in a prompt with no named recipient, and a written path with no recipient; then a prompt-only path, no trigger, a judgment trigger, a limit with no value, disagreements or stalls left out, escalations unrecorded, past escalations ending with no decision and escalations sent to the wrong recipient, with the fix for each. An incident escalation policy is wever_escalation-threshold-check and where a refused or silent handed-off task goes is wever_handoff-failure-check. Verdict escalation_missing, escalation_gaps, escalation_unverified or escalation_named. POST /api/coordination-escalation-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-coordination-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-coordination/.
